name: Book of the Ancients
summary: The Book of the Ancients holds secrets about the naga, kept for centuries. Azore Aldamort seeks it at Ethel Rethor to learn more about these scaled foes.

sections.title: A Serpent's Charge
sections.body: On Ranazjar Isle in Desolace, the Book of the Ancients lies under the guard of a naga protector. Azore Aldamort gives you the Gem of the Serpent and asks you to place it in the hand of the Serpent Statue. The book holds knowledge of the naga that has been kept for centuries, and Azore means to study it.

sections.title: To the High Council
sections.body: When you bring the book back to Azore at the tower in Ethel Rethor, he promises to pass it to the Argent Dawn's high council. He hopes its old secrets will teach them much about their scaled foes.

faq.q: What is in the Book of the Ancients?
faq.answer: The Book of the Ancients contains secrets about the naga that have been kept for centuries.

faq.q: Where is the Book of the Ancients?
faq.answer: The book is guarded on Ranazjar Isle in Desolace.
Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor seeks the book so its knowledge can help the Argent Dawn.

faq.q: What is the Gem of the Serpent for?
faq.answer: Azore Aldamort gives you the Gem of the Serpent to place in the hand of the Serpent Statue on Ranazjar Isle, summoning the book's protector.
Azore Aldamort says he will pass the book to the Argent Dawn's high council.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, the Book of the Ancients offers the Argent Dawn knowledge of the naga, foes who threaten the coast.
